title: Mixed Event — Unfading Wishing — Episode2 For the New Year's Stream!

meta.Episode: Episode2 — For the New Year's Stream!
meta.Event Outline: The US trip is coming up fast, and Akito's been practicing at full throttle. He takes a well-earned break on New Year's Day, but while he's out and about, he ends up running into a certain someone...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
I'm glad that our final stream of the year went as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “New Year's Eve With MORE MORE JUMP!” was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'd love to make my own soba noodles again! Especially since they ended up being so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, we got a lot of viewers this time around.
I have to think that your commercial did the trick again for us, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That certainly would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's keep up the momentum starting tomorrow when the new year begins.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You all sound very excited about the upcoming year.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Things might be a little hard right now, but I'm sure you girls will find a way to overcome this obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's switch gears and start preparing for our next stream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though we have New Year's Day off, we'll be streaming on the second. So, we'll need to get everything in order for that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, about that...
I thought we could do some extra segments. What do you guys think?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That sounds wonderful!
After all, we want everyone to have as much fun as possible.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But what kinds of extra segments should we do?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're only just now planning them, so we probably won't be able to do anything too involved...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, what do you already have planned for your stream on the second?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... We're going to draw our fortunes using the omikuji boxes we made, and make the New Year's dishes our fans request and have a little feast together. It should be pretty festive.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow!
That sounds like such a fun New Year's stream!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is important to do seasonal stuff for these kinds of streams.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, does that mean your extra segments should also have a New Year's feel to them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A New Year's feel...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, what if you did another stream about New Year's games?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Another stream about New Year's games?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because we heard that the one you did last year went very well. You may have some new fans watching, so it could be good to do another one.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It did go pretty well last time...
But we sort of landed on trying not to do anything too similar to what we've already done.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right.
But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see nothing wrong with that idea!
It should be fun for everyone, as long as we change up which games we play.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, good point.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, it's settled!
Your extra segments will be another round of New Year's games!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, let's start deciding which games we're going to play, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We have a long list of options.
But the ones that would make our New Year's stream fun for everyone would be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... We played Karuta and Fukuwarai last time... So, for this stream, what if we made mochi together? We could take turns using the pestle!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm not sure many people would count making mochi as a New Year's game...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, even if we started looking now, I doubt we'd be able to find a proper mortar and pestle in time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right... I thought it was a good idea, since we didn't get a chance to last time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, actually... What if we played a true-to-life version of Fukuwarai?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A true-to-life version?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! People on social media have been talking about how you can take pictures of each other and make cutouts using them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. And it would be a fresh take on something we've already done, so we could have a lot of fun with it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I'll put true-to-life Fukuwarai on the list. What else can we play...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Fukuwarai is definitely a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But nothing else seems to fit the bill.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well...
Playing with spinning tops and kites would be fun, but they're missing that extra something...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
At least one more game would be nice.
Ideally, something that involves us competing against each other, since everyone watching could try to guess who's going to win...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But we also don't have a lot of time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try finding something tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Find? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As it so happens, I'm gonna go check out the New Year's sales with Ena tomorrow. I'll try seeing if the toy stores and stuff have anything we can use.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right...
A toy store could provide you with some new insights...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Airi, would it be possible for me to join you tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Seeing what each store carries may help me come up with a good idea.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'd like to do what I can to help you all shine as brightly as possible when you do play these games!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, you're absolutely welcome to join us!
But I won't be able to talk to you much, since I'm gonna be there with my friend. If you're okay with that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll take quick peeks while staying hidden in your pocket!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Then, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make our New Year's stream a good one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
